site_name: Land bounded by Hepscott Road and Rothbury Road, TSVC Building, London, E9 5H
description: Application for non-material amendment of planning permission dated 21/12/2015, ref: 17/00222/FUL. Non Material Amendment(s) Sought: Lightwells to the rear of the commercial units have been removed and landscape space has been increased at podium level.  Voids in the deck access walkways to Blocks A and D have been omitted. Windows on these walkways reconfigured as wider opening with brickwork below  Height of the brick stallrisers below the commercial windows to Commercial Units 1 and 2 in Blocks A and B have been increased by up to 37.5cm.  Proposed perforated metal screens in front of the ground floor glazing to the commercial units have been replaced with a patterned manifestation on the glazing.  Perforated metal panels to the ancillary areas at ground floor have been replaced with louvred panels and railings. Gable end wall to block D (the boundary of the adjacent Lee Tavern site) is proposed as fair faced concrete blockwork. Small area of glazing at the rear of block D is to be omitted. Air source heat pump enclosure on the roof of Block B reduced in size of its footprint.
